Claude Sonnet 5.5 *.description: The page image is sent to this general vision-language model through OpenRouter. Separate prompts request page HTML and labeled layout boxes.
Claude Sonnet 5.5 *.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5 *

Datalab accurate (Datalab).description: Datalab converts each page through its hosted accurate pipeline. Returned chunks supply the labeled regions; its HTML supplies the text.
Datalab accurate (Datalab).label: Datalab accurate

Datalab balanced (Datalab).description: Datalab converts each page through its hosted balanced pipeline. Returned chunks supply the labeled regions; its HTML supplies the text.
Datalab balanced (Datalab).label: Datalab balanced

Reducto.description: Reducto r-1 processes the uploaded page asynchronously. The adapter reads its page content and typed blocks.
Reducto.label: Reducto

LlamaParse.description: The v2 parsing API runs the Agentic Plus tier. The adapter rejoins page headers, Markdown and footers, and reads layout boxes throughout the item tree.

settings.Version requested: latest; no resolved model version stated

LlamaParse.label: LlamaParse

Mistral OCR.description: Mistral OCR 4.1 returns page Markdown and typed regions. The adapter puts separate tables, headers and footers back into the text.

settings.Options: HTML tables; blocks, headers and footers on; image data off

Mistral OCR.label: Mistral OCR

Azure.description: Azure Content Understanding analyzes pages with its prebuilt layout analyzer. Paragraph roles, tables and figures supply the layout boxes. This is a different product from Azure Document Intelligence queued in our study.
Azure.label: Azure Content Understanding

Extend.description: Extend uploads the page and starts an asynchronous parse run. Its returned blocks supply both the page content and labeled regions.
Extend.label: Extend

chandra-ocr-2 (Datalab).description: Chandra OCR 2 reads the page image and returns structured content with labeled regions. The benchmark keeps page headers and footers.
chandra-ocr-2 (Datalab).label: Chandra OCR 2

LightOnOCR-3-4B.description: The LightOnOCR-3 4B checkpoint reads page images and emits text associated with labeled regions. The adapter maps its title and continuation labels to benchmark blocks.
LightOnOCR-3-4B.label: LightOnOCR-3-4B

LightOnOCR-3-0.8B.description: The LightOnOCR-3 0.8B checkpoint reads page images and emits text associated with labeled regions. The adapter maps its title and continuation labels to benchmark blocks.
LightOnOCR-3-0.8B.label: LightOnOCR-3-0.8B

MinerU2.5-Pro.description: MinerU2.5-Pro uses the served document parsing pipeline. Its content and native block types are converted to HTML and benchmark layout labels.
MinerU2.5-Pro.label: MinerU2.5-Pro

OvisOCR3.description: OvisOCR3 is called twice per page: its Markdown prompt produces text and its structured prompt produces labeled boxes. Our study uses its Markdown output for heading levels.
OvisOCR3.label: OvisOCR3

MiniCPM-OCR-1.0.description: The official MiniCPM document parsing SDK uses PP-DocLayoutV3 to locate regions, then MiniCPM-OCR-1.0 recognizes their content.
MiniCPM-OCR-1.0.label: MiniCPM-OCR-1.0

PaddleOCR-VL-1.6.description: The PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 pipeline produces recognized content and labeled page regions. Its native title categories become heading blocks.
PaddleOCR-VL-1.6.label: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6

dots.mocr.description: dots.mocr reads page images and returns content with category labels and boxes. The adapter distinguishes titles, section headings, body text and page furniture.
dots.mocr.label: dots.mocr

Infinity-Parser2-Pro.description: The Pro checkpoint of Infinity-Parser2 reads page images. The adapter converts its native content and box categories into HTML and labeled regions.
Infinity-Parser2-Pro.label: Infinity-Parser2-Pro

Infinity-Parser2-Flash.description: The Flash checkpoint of Infinity-Parser2 reads page images. The adapter converts its native content and box categories into HTML and labeled regions.
Infinity-Parser2-Flash.label: Infinity-Parser2-Flash

OCRia-1 (+ vendor grounding, Docling Her.description: OCRia-1 reads page text. Its experimental vendor grounding code and the Docling Heron detector add the layout boxes. This score describes that combined pipeline.
OCRia-1 (+ vendor grounding, Docling Her.label: OCRia-1 + Heron

Surya OCR 2 (Datalab).description: Surya OCR 2 runs in its own GPU server. The adapter converts its text and native region labels, including section headers, to the benchmark format.
Surya OCR 2 (Datalab).label: Surya OCR 2

Surya OCR 2.5 (Datalab).description: Surya OCR 2.5 runs in its own GPU server. The adapter converts its text and native region labels, including section headers, to the benchmark format.
Surya OCR 2.5 (Datalab).label: Surya OCR 2.5

OXR-1.0.description: SoMark’s own parsing API runs OXR-1.0 and returns page content with labeled regions. The adapter retains HTML, Markdown and layout blocks.
OXR-1.0.label: OXR-1.0

Nemotron 3.5 Parse.description: NVIDIA’s parser uses triple mode: a full-page pass, a detection pass and additional table/chart crops. The benchmark reads its content and regions.
Nemotron 3.5 Parse.label: Nemotron 3.5 Parse

GLM-OCR.description: GLM-OCR runs through its SDK’s self-hosted pipeline. The adapter reads recognized content and native layout categories, including document and paragraph titles.
GLM-OCR.label: GLM-OCR

Unlimited-OCR.description: Unlimited-OCR reads page images with its own labeled output format. Titles and subtitles become heading blocks; page headers remain separate.
Unlimited-OCR.label: Unlimited-OCR

Unlimited-OCR 2.description: Unlimited-OCR 2 reads tiled page images. Its labels identify text, headings and regions continued across pages or columns.
Unlimited-OCR 2.label: Unlimited-OCR 2

MonkeyOCR.description: MonkeyOCR-pro-3B uses its layout and recognition pipeline. The benchmark also reads regions the layout model would otherwise abandon, then restores their original labels.
MonkeyOCR.label: MonkeyOCR-pro-3B

Indra OCR (Datalab).description: Indra OCR 1.2.0 runs on CPU through ONNX Runtime. Its native block boxes supply the layout; math recognition is enabled.

settings.Execution: One worker process per CPU core

Indra OCR (Datalab).label: Indra OCR 1.2

DeepSeek-OCR-2.description: DeepSeek-OCR-2 reads page images and emits content with region categories. Its title and subtitle categories become heading blocks.
DeepSeek-OCR-2.label: DeepSeek-OCR-2

LiteParse (ocria-nano).description: LiteParse uses the ocria-nano recognition and LayoutNet models on CPU. The output includes page headers and footers as separate region types.
LiteParse (ocria-nano).label: LiteParse + ocria-nano

HunyuanOCR-1.5.description: HunyuanOCR runs its layout_parse task to obtain text and labeled regions. The adapter reads the vendor’s native region categories.
HunyuanOCR-1.5.label: HunyuanOCR-1.5

Docling.description: Docling’s standard PDF pipeline combines text extraction, RapidOCR and layout analysis. Its own HTML export and labeled document items are scored.

settings.OCR: RapidOCR, auto choice in the published image

Docling.label: Docling

Docling (formula).description: Docling’s standard pipeline adds CodeFormulaV2 to read formula regions as LaTeX. The adapter reads the HTML export’s TeX annotations.

settings.Published hardware: B200; cuDNN attention disabled for formula stage

Docling (formula).label: Docling + formulas

PP-StructureV3.description: PaddleOCR’s PPStructureV3 combines several models to read content and page layout. It preserves every block and transforms boxes back to the original page orientation.
PP-StructureV3.label: PP-StructureV3

PyMuPDF4LLM (OCR).description: PyMuPDF4LLM 2.1 reads one page at a time with OCR enabled. Markdown supplies the text and the JSON export supplies layout boxes.

settings.OCR: use_ocr=True; Tesseract in the published run

PyMuPDF4LLM (OCR).label: PyMuPDF4LLM (OCR)
